7ff3aa48-c1c5-44cd-ac10-66285b807e69/Eve.en: Xiangshu's massive form loomed, almost blotting out the sky.<NL>Endless black mist and blood-red ash poured from the demon,<NL>the darkness swallowing the daylight and sweeping across the land like a tidal wave.<NL>In an instant, the world was shrouded in shadow, leaving no escape in sight!
7ff3aa48-c1c5-44cd-ac10-66285b807e69/Eve.cn: 相枢身躯庞然，几欲遮蔽天地。<NL>但见无尽的黑雾与血灰，自那妖魔身上四散而出，<NL>漆黑的雾气仿佛将天光也吞吃，裹挟着漫天血灰，如浪潮般自远处席卷而来，<NL>霎时间，天地间尽被阴霾笼罩，眼看已是无处可逃！
7ff3aa48-c1c5-44cd-ac10-66285b807e69/Eve.ru: Массивная фигура Сяншу вырисовывалась, почти заслоняя небо.<NL>Бесконечный черный туман и кроваво-красный пепел исходили от демона,<NL>тьма поглощает дневной свет и захлестывает землю подобно приливной волне.<NL>В одно мгновение мир погрузился в тень, не оставляя возможности спастись!

a207a93b-28e6-452a-86f4-ff1a40f4d3b6/Eve.en: Yet, amidst the all-encompassing darkness,<NL>a faint glimmer suddenly appeared.<NL>In the blink of an eye, tiny points of light began to emerge and gradually illuminate the sky...
a207a93b-28e6-452a-86f4-ff1a40f4d3b6/Eve.cn: 然而，就在这漫天蔽野的黑暗之中，<NL>却倏然透出一缕微光，再一眨眼，便见星星点点的光芒，<NL>自天际缓缓萌生、次第亮起……
a207a93b-28e6-452a-86f4-ff1a40f4d3b6/Eve.ru: И все же, среди всеохватывающей тьмы,<NL>внезапно появилось слабое мерцание.<NL>В мгновение ока начали появляться крошечные точки света, которые постепенно освещали небо...

e724a86f-c4c9-4b46-b6b2-ed40c0ad7a34/Eve.en: Beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, the illusion of a woman<NL>seemed to perceive the fierce battle's brutality.<NL>Silently, she drifted away from Taiwu, becoming a streak of light that flew straight toward the demon and where Huanxin once stood!<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s heart tightened, and they couldn't help but call out—
e724a86f-c4c9-4b46-b6b2-ed40c0ad7a34/Eve.cn: 却见身侧那一缕女子幻影，<NL>仿佛也望清那场苦战之惨烈，此时竟悄然离了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<NL>似一线流光，径直朝那妖魔与昔日焕心所在之处飞去！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心头猛地一紧，不由得脱口唤出一声——

127b290a-0f3a-446c-938e-9ec0c2ed14dd/Eve.en: Huanxin's lingering thoughts halted at the sound, turning back with tears in her eyes and a sorrowful expression.<NL>Strands of moonlit blue hair brushed her face, as if she mourned the suffering of the world...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finally saw clearly—<NL>the figure was Huanxin, the one they had once rescued from the Otherland!
127b290a-0f3a-446c-938e-9ec0c2ed14dd/Eve.cn: 那一缕焕心的心念，闻声止住去势，蓦然回首，<NL>但见她双目垂泪，神容哀悯，几缕月蓝发丝随风拂面，似因心怜苍生疾苦，悲不能已……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />此刻终于看得分明——<NL>那道身影，正是自己当初从出神之地救出的焕心！

8fb1c25d-1e61-4f6e-a8e0-9830b4fa869a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> furrowed their brow, watching<NL>as beams of white light emerged from the village, slowly rising to pierce the black mist<NL>and illuminate the sky!<NL>Beneath this pure light, the demon drew near, yet none of the villagers fled...
8fb1c25d-1e61-4f6e-a8e0-9830b4fa869a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />凝眉望去，<NL>只见那道道白光，原来竟是自村中生出，<NL>少顷渐渐升腾而起，穿透黑雾，终于映亮苍空！<NL>于此清光之下，妖魔已然迫近眼前，村中百姓却无一人奔逃避走……
8fb1c25d-1e61-4f6e-a8e0-9830b4fa869a/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> нахмурили брови, наблюдая<NL>когда лучи белого света появились из деревни, медленно поднимаясь, чтобы пронзить черный туман<NL>и освети небо!<NL>Под этим чистым светом демон приближался, но никто из жителей деревни не бежал...

d5c4adfb-238b-419e-8204-bf36064c34d5/Eve.en: As the black mist approached, bringing disaster,<NL>some villagers hid under eaves while others looked skyward, terror-stricken.<NL>Yet, upon closer inspection, a deep-seated faith seemed to lie within their eyes.<NL>Their lips moved slightly, as if quietly encouraging themselves...
d5c4adfb-238b-419e-8204-bf36064c34d5/Eve.cn: 黑雾趋近，祸之将至，<NL>村中百姓有的躲藏檐下，有的仰首望天，早已是惊恐万状，<NL>可细观众人神色，其眸中深处，却又好似暗藏笃信，<NL>人人唇间微翕，心怀期许，竟似在低声打气一般……
d5c4adfb-238b-419e-8204-bf36064c34d5/Eve.ru: По мере приближения черного тумана, приносящего бедствие,<NL>некоторые жители деревни прятались под карнизами, в то время как другие в ужасе смотрели в небо.<NL>И все же, при ближайшем рассмотрении, в их глазах, казалось, таилась глубоко укоренившаяся вера.<NL>Их губы слегка шевелились, словно тихо подбадривая самих себя...

d5c4adfb-238b-419e-8204-bf36064c34d5/Opt.en: (With hope in one's heart, humanity will triumph...)

96132b80-a9f9-4a10-8494-cbc7892017ff/Eve.en: Under the eaves, between the fields... <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gazes upon the villagers, who despite their fear and confusion, <NL>remain steadfast, pouring their hopes and dreams into this place, refusing to abandon their homes. <NL><NL>From these gathered thoughts, faint glimmers of light emerge, rising slowly to the sky, <NL>eventually illuminating the entire village, shining upon the thatched cottages and winding paths...
96132b80-a9f9-4a10-8494-cbc7892017ff/Eve.cn: 屋檐之下，田埂之间……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />望遍此间村人，虽有惶惑惊惧，<NL>却仍是心怀赤忱，将满心热望期冀皆寄托于此，决然不愿弃家奔逃。<NL><NL>由此，心念所聚，缕缕微光便从这无数信念中生出，缓缓升起，直上云天，<NL>终于洒满整座村落，照彻茅屋草舍、阡陌小道……

96132b80-a9f9-4a10-8494-cbc7892017ff/Opt.en: The journey with Huanxin comes vividly to mind...
96132b80-a9f9-4a10-8494-cbc7892017ff/Opt.cn: 与焕心一路走来的行迹过往，宛在眼前……

e8e19809-10db-42ab-8f9f-c3f8bea230f0/Eve.en: In the dim light, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees a young woman standing in the field, <NL>her hands still stained with earth, unwashed and humble. <NL>She clasps her hands together, gazing up at the sky, murmuring softly: <NL><NL>"For the safety of my family... I must do my part... <NL>This land has provided for us, kept us safe and fed. No matter how many demons come today, we will stand firm... <NL>Whatever happens, I will not flee from here..."
e8e19809-10db-42ab-8f9f-c3f8bea230f0/Eve.cn: 微光之下，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />瞧见田间，<NL>仍还立着一名年轻女子，一双掌心尚沾田泥，质朴未洗，<NL>此刻她双手合拢，抬眸遥望着天穹，低声念叨着：<NL><NL>“为我家人平安……我定要使出一份力……<NL>此地既然有灵，叫咱们吃饱穿暖，日子安稳，今日就算来再多的妖魔，咱们也一定能顶住……<NL>无论如何，我可不愿逃离此地……”

22afecb5-e915-4dc6-be58-182c8815839c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turns their gaze to a family in the courtyard, <NL>where a man stands protectively in front of his loved ones, fists clenched tightly, shouting: <NL><NL>"Our village is blessed with exceptional people and a rich spirit. If we stand united, we can overcome any crisis! <NL>Don't panic, just hold your ground and protect our homeland..."
22afecb5-e915-4dc6-be58-182c8815839c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眸光一转，又望向一户人家院前，<NL>正见一名男子挺身将家人护在身后，双拳死死握紧，高声喊道：<NL><NL>“咱们村子，人杰地灵，只要大伙齐心，纵有再大的危难也能扛过去！<NL>大伙莫要惊慌，只管守住这片乡土便是……”

01d39ccf-0383-4b2d-a6b7-2ce848165be3/Eve.en: The more <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks, the clearer the scenes of the village become. <NL>There are children who haven't managed to escape, huddling with the family's chickens and dogs, hiding beside the woodpile. <NL>Their faces are pale, but their young voices carry a hint of determination: <NL><NL>"The demons must know how good our place is, that's why they want to take over our home..." <NL>"Don't be afraid, just keep hiding like this. Soon, the adults will drive the demons away..." <NL>"I'll train hard from now on. When I grow up, I'll stand up and protect our village too!"
01d39ccf-0383-4b2d-a6b7-2ce848165be3/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />愈望，便愈能瞧清村中种种情状，<NL>还有好些稚童，尚且不及逃开，只好依偎着家中鸡犬，缩躲在柴垛侧边，<NL>那些孩童脸色煞白，彼此靠拢，稚嫩的声音却已有几分决意：<NL><NL>“妖魔定是知晓咱们这儿好，才要来霸占咱们的家园……”<NL>“别怕别怕，只管如这般躲藏起来，再过不久，大人们定能把那妖魔赶跑……”<NL>“我此后一定好好习武，等我长大，也要挺身守护咱们村子！”

9574701a-8d19-469f-9d0b-cffcf01e9a93/Eve.en: Previously, alongside Huanxin, <NL>we protected this small, remote village, day by day, until it became a peaceful haven for the people. <NL>But now, demons tread the land, destruction spreads far and wide, <NL>and the devouring black mist and blood-red ash are perilously close!
9574701a-8d19-469f-9d0b-cffcf01e9a93/Eve.cn: 此前与焕心相伴，<NL>护着这一处小小荒村，日往月来，终成百姓安居的一方乡土。<NL>然而此刻，妖魔踏地，四野焚摧，<NL>那吞吃天地的黑雾与血灰却已在咫尺之间！
9574701a-8d19-469f-9d0b-cffcf01e9a93/Eve.ru: Ранее вместе с Хуаньсинем, <NL>мы защищали эту маленькую, отдаленную деревню день за днем, пока она не стала мирным пристанищем для людей. <NL>Но теперь демоны ступают по земле, разрушение распространяется повсюду, <NL>а всепожирающий черный туман и кроваво-красный пепел опасно близки!

6b85d6ad-7b6d-4ab9-a484-429faa0ad694/Eve.en: In an instant, the specks of white light intertwined and formed a barrier,<NL>holding back the encroaching black mist and crimson ash!<NL>As the sky darkened, the mist halted outside the white glow,<NL>while the red ashes fell silently to the ground, unable to spread any further...
6b85d6ad-7b6d-4ab9-a484-429faa0ad694/Eve.cn: 顷刻，却见那点点白光彼此交织、牵连，<NL>竟而化作一道屏障，生生挡下那漫天的黑雾与血灰！<NL>只见天昏地暗间，雾气就此凝滞于白光之外，那殷红的灰烬亦簌簌飘落，<NL>没入地表，再也无力蔓延分毫……
6b85d6ad-7b6d-4ab9-a484-429faa0ad694/Eve.ru: В одно мгновение пятнышки белого света переплелись и образовали барьер,<NL>сдерживая надвигающийся черный туман и багровый пепел!<NL>Когда небо потемнело, туман остановился за пределами белого свечения,<NL>в то время как красный пепел беззвучно падал на землю, не в силах распространиться дальше...

6b85d6ad-7b6d-4ab9-a484-429faa0ad694/Opt.en: The villagers' collective faith has conjured such formidable power!
6b85d6ad-7b6d-4ab9-a484-429faa0ad694/Opt.cn: 此地村人信念汇聚，竟能生出这般强韧之力！
6b85d6ad-7b6d-4ab9-a484-429faa0ad694/Opt.ru: Коллективная вера жителей деревни создала такую огромную силу!

40b28a93-0888-4d11-b27a-5a650e16a89f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was momentarily shaken<NL>but dared not lose focus.<NL><NL>They saw that while the white light kept the black mist and crimson ash at bay, countless boulders, debris, and even entire hills had been uprooted by the mist and were crashing down with thunderous force,<NL>causing the ground to tremble!<NL><NL>The sky rumbled, dust hung thick in the air,<NL>and danger loomed over the village like a precarious balance...
40b28a93-0888-4d11-b27a-5a650e16a89f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心神为之一震，<NL>却又片刻未敢分神，定睛看去，<NL>那白光虽已将黑雾血灰阻隔在外，半空中仍有无数巨石、土砾，乃至整座小丘，<NL>早已被那黑雾裹挟着拔地而起，更以风雷之势，<NL>向四下里毫无顾忌地砸落下来，震得地面不住颤抖！<NL><NL>只听得天际隆隆作响，尘土弥漫不散，<NL>村中此刻，仍是险象环生，危如累卵……

40b28a93-0888-4d11-b27a-5a650e16a89f/Opt.en: In this dire situation, there is still something I can do...
40b28a93-0888-4d11-b27a-5a650e16a89f/Opt.cn: 这般局面，我尚有可为之事……
40b28a93-0888-4d11-b27a-5a650e16a89f/Opt.ru: В этой ужасной ситуации я все еще могу кое-что сделать...

54bf5785-4d9f-4be0-8f2c-553ad5edb347/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> knew they were merely a fragment of consciousness,<NL>without a physical form to confront the demons directly, let alone repel them.<NL><NL>The village was in chaos, danger lurked everywhere, and they wondered if their meager strength could still make a difference.<NL><NL>Amidst their anxiety, cries of distress rose from the village—shouts, sobs, and calls for help echoed all around.<NL><NL>Among the cacophony, they could faintly discern the anxious calls of Doctor Ning and their spouse, growing more urgent with each cry...<NL>"Qi, Qimei! Has anyone seen Qi..."
54bf5785-4d9f-4be0-8f2c-553ad5edb347/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />自知不过一缕心念，<NL>眼下既无肉身，难与妖魔正面相搏，更不必说将其击退。<NL>眼下村中乱作一团，处处凶险，却不知自己这般微末之力，可还有能为之事？<NL><NL>正自心焦之际，村中已是悲声四起，<NL>或有惊叫，或有悲泣，更有呼救之声此起彼伏，<NL>而那杂乱的声浪中，隐隐辨得宁大夫夫妇的焦灼呼唤，一声急过一声……<NL><NL>“七妹，七妹！可曾有人见到七妹……”

54bf5785-4d9f-4be0-8f2c-553ad5edb347/Opt.en: Qi is missing? (A chill running through their mind!)
54bf5785-4d9f-4be0-8f2c-553ad5edb347/Opt.ru: Отсутствует Ци? (Холодок пробегает по их разуму!)

59afa302-ca70-4495-b3b9-a9f082d3218f/Eve.en: From afar, they saw the old demon Xiangshu,<NL>seemingly intent on crushing the earth and shattering the heavens,<NL>as torrents of crimson ash surged around them and the black mist intensified!<NL>More and more boulders and hills crashed down, shaking the earth violently, and amidst the unsettled dust,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> heard a faint cry from the nearby ruins...
59afa302-ca70-4495-b3b9-a9f082d3218f/Eve.cn: 远远望见那相枢老魔，<NL>似要踏碎大地，撞破苍天，<NL>滚滚血灰自其周身涌出，黑雾也愈发猛烈起来！<NL>愈来愈多的巨石与小山，劈头盖脸砸落，又待一阵地动山摇，尘埃犹未落定，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />便听得不远处的废墟堆中，传来一声微弱至极的哭泣……

59afa302-ca70-4495-b3b9-a9f082d3218f/Opt.en: (Calming their mind and reaching out towards the source of the crying...)
59afa302-ca70-4495-b3b9-a9f082d3218f/Opt.ru: (Успокаивают свой разум и тянутся к источнику плача...)

c07b9649-4c1b-46e3-94f1-af9b6571469f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> focused intently, following the sound of the crying.<NL>Soon, they reached a collapsed wall where the cries grew clearer—it was Qi!<NL><NL><NL>The area was unrecognizable, battered by falling stones, and amidst the rubble, Qi's small figure was huddled in a corner, sobbing, protected by someone shielding them...
c07b9649-4c1b-46e3-94f1-af9b6571469f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />立时聚精会神，心念循着哭声探寻而去，<NL>未久寻至一处塌陷墙根，那哭声愈发清晰可闻，听来正是七妹！<NL><NL>却见此地早已被落石砸得面目全非，断壁残垣之间，<NL>七妹小小的身躯缩在角落，不住啜泣，正被一人紧紧护在身下……

deaba2d2-b140-4c9c-977e-49ff127734b6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looked closely<NL>and realized that the person was the one who had been gravely injured before, covered in linen cloth.<NL>Though they were too weak to move, they still held on, shielding their sister from the collapsing beams and debris, keeping her safe...<NL><NL>Even as their back was a bloody mess, bones shattered, they had already passed away.<NL><NL>Yet, in their final moments, they held their sister tightly, not moving an inch, using their last breath to protect her...
deaba2d2-b140-4c9c-977e-49ff127734b6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />再一细看，<NL>那人正是此前身负重伤、以麻布覆身的伤者，<NL>其身纵已无力动弹，却仍死死撑着，为七妹挡下轰然坍塌的房梁砖瓦，护她周全……<NL><NL>又见那人腰背间早已血肉模糊，骨断筋折，此刻已然气绝身亡，<NL>然其临终之姿，仍是紧紧将七妹揽在怀中，寸步不移，<NL>竟是耗尽最后一丝气力，以命相护……

deaba2d2-b140-4c9c-977e-49ff127734b6/Opt.en: (A wave of grief and anger surging within...)
deaba2d2-b140-4c9c-977e-49ff127734b6/Opt.ru: (Волна горя и гнева захлестывает меня изнутри...)

f62b38f1-5b9b-47cf-91ed-05df9502555c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> felt a deep pain in their heart, a mix of shock and fury.<NL>Then they heard the demon's roar, thunderous and fierce, and looked up to see two figures locked in a desperate battle in the sky—one large and one small.<NL><NL>The massive figure, shrouded in dark mist and blood, was the demon Xiangshu;<NL>the smaller figure, wielding a broken sword hilt, fighting valiantly, was Huanxin from the past!<NL>Their fierce duel shook the heavens and earth, causing mountains to crumble...
f62b38f1-5b9b-47cf-91ed-05df9502555c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只觉痛心切骨，胸中惊怒交加，<NL>又听得妖魔怒吼，咄嗟如雷，抬眼只见一大一小两个身影，正在空中拼死搏杀——<NL><NL>那巨大的身影，通天彻地，浑身裹着黑雾血灰，便是妖魔相枢；<NL>那小小的身影，手持一把断刃的剑柄，左支右绌，浴血苦战，便是昔日的焕心！<NL>两者死斗已酣，直搅得天地变色，山崩地毁……

45e6a56c-e7f7-4dc3-88c9-ef67495017ef/Eve.en: Huanxin's thoughts lingered on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>and with a sorrowful sigh, they spoke:<NL> "Taiwu, perhaps our thoughts have returned to this moment from centuries ago for this very reason..."
45e6a56c-e7f7-4dc3-88c9-ef67495017ef/Eve.cn: 焕心的心念凝望着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<NL>终是幽幽一叹，语带悲声：<NL>“太吾，你我的心念得以同回这数百年前，或许……便是为了此刻……”

6efaba1f-6690-4ae4-99a3-f60a502a1a81/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> теперь это всего лишь фрагмент мысли,<NL>без физической формы, чтобы обладать какой-либо силой.<NL>Чтобы спасти Хуаньсинь от опасности, единственный путь - найти судно для обитания...

8b470518-847a-4ab9-9600-f23c95d15e70/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> closed their eyes,<NL>casting aside all distractions, pouring every ounce of their thoughts into that person.<NL>As their spirit seeped into the sea of consciousness,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> felt their limbs grow heavy, agony piercing their back, and breathing becoming labored...
8b470518-847a-4ab9-9600-f23c95d15e70/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />立时阖目，<NL>将诸般杂念尽数抛却，倾尽自身全部心念，向那人身上汇注而去。<NL>随着心神如烟入雾，一点一滴渗入其灵识之海，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />只觉四肢百骸渐渐沉重，腰背处传来钻心剧痛，呼吸也变得艰难起来……

1deb1aec-d69e-4324-aa72-029bb66dbba2/Eve.en: As soon as the question was asked, a faint voice drifted into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s consciousness—<NL><NL>it was the person, using the last of their strength to reply in a whisper: "Why hesitate to save a life..."<NL><NL>The moment the words faded, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s vision cleared,<NL>and they found themselves able to move freely, taking control of the broken body!<NL>Without a second thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> charged straight toward Xiangshu!
1deb1aec-d69e-4324-aa72-029bb66dbba2/Eve.cn: 此问一出，一缕幽渺之声，便缓缓汇入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />神识，<NL>竟是那人用尽最后一丝残力，低声作答：<NL>“救人，何必迟疑……”<NL><NL>话音方歇，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眼前豁然清朗，<NL>果真行动自如，执掌起这副残破躯壳！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />当即奋不顾身，提步直朝着相枢猛冲而去！

67b94693-f658-4737-997b-518094b560b2/Eve.en: Their body was battered and broken, with no part left unscathed, and their life was hanging by a thread.<NL>Yet, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, driven by sheer willpower, forced the body to rise.<NL>Step by step, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> began to move—first walking, then running faster and faster. Though they had no Qi, their determination brought forth a semblance of Footwork Arts!<NL>In that moment, no pain, no exhaustion could deter them.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s gaze remained fixed ahead, unwavering.
67b94693-f658-4737-997b-518094b560b2/Eve.cn: 此身骨裂筋伤，无处完好，早已气数将尽，<NL>然而，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />又以自身心念，强撑而起，竟当真教那双腿迈了出去，<NL>一步，两步，继而越跑越快，虽无内力，却终因<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心念凝聚，而身法渐起！<NL><NL>彼时，纵有千刀万剐之痛、气海耗竭之苦，亦已不足畏，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />双目无暇旁顾，只是定定凝视前方——

19a8d71d-3fe3-4f71-92b9-08cf0ef486d8/Eve.en: Blood surged up to their throat! <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> swallowed hard, gathered their strength, and pushed their body to the limit.<NL>With a burst of speed, they launched themselves like an arrow towards Xiangshu! <NL><NL>Ignoring the astragale's cutting winds and the agony that gripped them, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finally reached Huanxin—
19a8d71d-3fe3-4f71-92b9-08cf0ef486d8/Eve.cn: 一口热血涌上喉头！<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />咬牙咽下，复又运气提息，<NL>将这具身躯逼至极限，身形一展，蹬地而起，如离弦之箭扑向相枢！<NL><NL>任凭罡风割面、剧痛缠身，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />终于扑至焕心身前——

12b332d1-f968-4339-91fc-e74b77df010b/Eve.en: Behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>the old demon Xiangshu was cloaked in black flames, its eight arms stretched across the sky, dangerously close! <NL>In front of them stood the Huanxin of old, eyes reflecting the raging black flames, staring at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> in shock. <NL>Before they could speak, their strength gave out, and they seemed ready to collapse into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s arms... <NL><NL>Meanwhile, the black flame blade was already slicing through the air—
12b332d1-f968-4339-91fc-e74b77df010b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身后，<NL>那相枢老魔黑焰缠身，八臂横空，近在咫尺之间！<NL>在其眼前，却是昔日焕心，眸中映着腾腾黑焰，惊怔望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<NL>未及开口言语，她便已无力支撑，整个身子摇摇欲坠，似要落入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />怀中……<NL><NL>而那黑焰剑刃已然破空而来——

b7559486-4692-4610-899e-5809e0e712ac/Eve.en: Without a moment's hesitation, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> held Huanxin tightly! <NL>But their mortal body was no match for the unstoppable force of the black flame blade,<NL>which pierced through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s torso and then through Huanxin, pinning them both to the ground! <NL><NL>A thunderous crash echoed as the blade drove into the scorched earth, <NL>splitting the ground wide open, sending debris flying and dust swirling everywhere...
b7559486-4692-4610-899e-5809e0e712ac/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不及多想，只将焕心牢牢护在怀中！<NL>然而这副身躯终究不过肉体凡胎，只见那黑焰剑刃势如破竹，无可阻挡，<NL>霎时贯穿<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />胸背，又穿透焕心身躯，将两人一起狠狠钉向地面！<NL><NL>只听得一阵轰然巨响，剑刃钉穿焦土，<NL>大地应声裂开一道巨大的豁口，碎石飞溅，尘土漫天……

f33213dd-ea2d-4a57-9bac-86bf50da1592/Eve.en: A stream of light, born from Huanxin's thoughts,<NL>quietly enveloped <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and the Huanxin of old. <NL>Though they were spared from fatal injury, beneath them lay the endless depths of a massive chasm. <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looked down, feeling their spirit crumble, their mind empty, as if their soul was being torn into countless pieces, <NL>ready to be dragged into the abyss below—
f33213dd-ea2d-4a57-9bac-86bf50da1592/Eve.cn: 那道由焕心心念所化的流光，<NL>悄然飞来，将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />与昔日焕心轻轻护住。<NL>虽未因坠落伤及性命，二人身下，却唯有那深不见底的万丈裂渊，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />低头望去，一时心神俱颓，万念皆空，魂魄似要被撕扯成千百碎片，<NL>即刻便要被拖入那裂缝之下，无底的玄狱之中——

f33213dd-ea2d-4a57-9bac-86bf50da1592/Opt.ru: (Я не могу... пусть это закончится здесь...)

9454357a-8008-4f33-8544-dba59e021c9d/Eve.en: The world fell silent, all around was still, yet <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s heart surged with relentless defiance! <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> held the Huanxin of old tightly, as blood soaked their clothes, <NL>struggling with all their might to climb upwards... but the black flame blade held them fast, <NL>and the body they inhabited was spent, with no strength left to break free... <NL>Faintly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> heard Huanxin's gentle call, but it was too indistinct to understand...
9454357a-8008-4f33-8544-dba59e021c9d/Eve.cn: 天地失声，四野俱寂，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中却涌出无尽不甘！<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />紧紧搂住昔日焕心，任凭汩汩鲜血浸透二人衣襟，<NL>只一味拼尽全力，欲要向上挣攀……然那黑焰剑刃却将二人死死钉住，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />所驱附的这具身躯，终究油尽灯枯，再无半分挣脱之力……<NL>耳畔隐约传来焕心的轻声呼唤，却都已听不真切……

9454357a-8008-4f33-8544-dba59e021c9d/Opt.en: (This blade holds me... I must pull it out...)
9454357a-8008-4f33-8544-dba59e021c9d/Opt.cn: （这剑刃阻我……我便要将之……拔除……）
9454357a-8008-4f33-8544-dba59e021c9d/Opt.ru: (Этот Клинок держит меня... Я должен вытащить его...)

e4ebbfde-e310-4fff-9922-28baa8dbfffe/Eve.en: With blood nearly drained and spirit on the verge of dissipation,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, driven by sheer will, suddenly reached out and grasped the blade tightly.<NL>Their palm was a mess of blood and flesh, the pain excruciating, yet they seemed oblivious...<NL><NL>At that moment, a warmth spread from the wound, flowing through their entire being.<NL>The faint glow surrounding them transformed into an illusion, appearing before<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />. With a surge of divine power, they seized the black flame blade from the void!
e4ebbfde-e310-4fff-9922-28baa8dbfffe/Eve.cn: 此身鲜血几近流尽，三魂似已溃散……<NL>然<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心念驱使，又猛然探出一掌，将那剑刃死死握住，<NL>掌心血肉模糊，痛楚彻骨，却仿佛已然不觉……<NL><NL>便在这时，忽有一股暖意自伤口缓缓蔓延，向四肢百骸散去——<NL>只见方才那萦绕周身的微光，刹那间化作一道幻影，于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身前显现而出，<NL>她奋起一股神力，竟从虚无之中，牢牢抓住了那黑焰剑刃！

4f6deed8-af9e-4fb0-832d-aca0bf07a35a/Eve.en: Huanxin's will, both real and ethereal, gradually took shape.<NL>Small hands somehow gripped the blade, straining to pull it free!<NL>Her moon-blue hair floated like a celestial being's, and in a fleeting moment, a clear tear silently fell onto<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand...
4f6deed8-af9e-4fb0-832d-aca0bf07a35a/Eve.cn: 只见焕心的心念似实又虚，轮廓渐渐清晰，<NL>一双小小的手掌不知如何攥住那剑刃，倾尽全力，欲将之向外拔出！<NL>她那月蓝的发丝飘然如仙，恍惚间，竟似有一滴清澈的泪，<NL>无声无息地落在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />手上……
4f6deed8-af9e-4fb0-832d-aca0bf07a35a/Eve.ru: Воля Хуаньсиня, как реальная, так и неземная, постепенно обретала форму.<NL>Маленькие ручки каким-то образом ухватились за Клинок, напрягаясь, чтобы вытащить его!<NL>Ее лунно-голубые волосы развевались, как у небесного существа, и в мимолетное мгновение прозрачная слеза беззвучно упала на<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />чья-то рука...

4f6deed8-af9e-4fb0-832d-aca0bf07a35a/Opt.cn: 焕心……你是如何能够握住这黑焰剑柄……

d39cee06-661a-488c-990f-9b23314e3d8d/Eve.en: Huanxin's will trembled slightly at the lips,<NL>eyes filled with boundless compassion, softly speaking to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />:<NL><NL>"Do not fear... do not worry...<NL>Taiwu, I am here and will never let you fall into the Abyss and suffer...<NL>Only you can vanquish the Xiangshu demon..."
d39cee06-661a-488c-990f-9b23314e3d8d/Eve.cn: 焕心的心念唇边微颤，<NL>眼中似有万千悲悯，望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />柔声说道：<NL><NL>“且莫慌……且莫忧……<NL>太吾，我已来了，便绝不会任你落下玄狱，受此苦楚……<NL>此世间唯有你，方能诛灭那相枢妖魔……”

c27d88b1-444f-4df6-82fe-9ec381bff088/Eve.en: Huanxin's will grasped the hilt,<NL>and the black flame coiled around her like a serpent, burning fiercely!<NL>Yet she uttered not a sound, enduring the pain with sheer will.<NL>Tiny sparks of light flew from her burning spirit, drifting towards<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and the wounds of the past Huanxin, dispelling the god-devouring black flame one by one...<NL><NL>Until her sorrowful agony reached its peak, her illusion nearly dissipated, she finally pulled the blade from the flesh,<NL>using her last ounce of strength to return it to the past Huanxin's side...
c27d88b1-444f-4df6-82fe-9ec381bff088/Eve.cn: 却见焕心的心念握住剑柄，<NL>黑焰立时如蛇缠上其身，猛烈灼烧起来！<NL>她却未曾发出一丝叫喊，只是强忍苦痛，生生承受，<NL>但见星星点点的光华，从她被焚毁的灵体中不断飞出，<NL>接连飘向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />与昔日焕心身上的伤口，竟将那噬神的黑焰逐一驱散灭除……<NL><NL>直至她痛苦已极，虚影几近散尽，才终于将那剑刃从血肉中拔出，<NL>竭尽最后一分力气，送回昔日焕心的手边……

fc24ea93-8ba8-42c3-b411-b3b21f61e50d/Eve.en: Sweat beaded on Huanxin's willful brow, yet her gaze remained bright and unwavering as she looked at<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and declared:<NL><NL>"Taiwu! 4bfa9897-fa66-44c7-ac60-335f923a951d/Eve.cn: 相枢见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />好生顽强，竟是个咬碎牙也不肯松口的硬骨头，<NL>又再细看，这才瞧见一支光秃秃的剑柄，正被<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />牢牢握在掌心。<NL><NL>妖魔陡然狞笑起来：<NL>“纵得「伏虞剑」又如何？有刃无柄，有柄无刃——<NL>终究是残缺不全的废物，半点用处也无！<NL>不如叫尔等在本座腹中团聚，也好做个伴！”<NL><NL>说罢，巨口已张，便要将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />连同「伏虞剑柄」一并吞吃！

01564382-c283-4e86-8122-b7516da505cd/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> could only manage a few broken words,<NL> but in the next instant, a burst of white light exploded from Xiangshu's throat, tearing a rift in the surrounding darkness!<NL><NL> The light grew ever brighter, blindingly white, revealing everything in its glow.<NL> Within the light, two spectral figures emerged—<NL> one was Huanxin, slender and faintly discernible;<NL> the other was the Fuyu Sword's blade, gleaming coldly, as if ready to pierce the heavens...
01564382-c283-4e86-8122-b7516da505cd/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />嗓中只挤出破碎字音，<NL>下一刹那，相枢咽喉之处，却猛然炸开一道白光，将漫天黑雾撕出一道裂口！<NL><NL>那光芒继而愈来愈盛，炽白耀目，照得万物无所遁形，<NL>隐约之间，白光中竟浮现出两道虚影——<NL>一道是昔日焕心，身形单薄，眉目依稀；<NL>另一道，正是伏虞剑刃，寒芒凛凛，似欲破空而出……

e0c008c6-5d6d-4602-858c-20f95c32d449/Eve.en: The two apparitions flickered between reality and illusion, <NL>but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> stared intently for a moment, finally convinced they were neither a mirage nor a figment of imagination!<NL>It turns out that the Huanxin and Fuyu Sword, once devoured by the demon, had not vanished completely.<NL>Now, resonating with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s unwavering resolve, they unleashed a mighty force that shook the heavens!<NL><NL>Xiangshu roared wildly, black flames and white light clashing fiercely, <NL>causing the colossal demon unbearable pain, forcing it to release <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> from its grasp...
e0c008c6-5d6d-4602-858c-20f95c32d449/Eve.cn: 那两道虚影似真似幻，朦胧可辨，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />定定凝望片刻，终是确信那并非幻觉，亦非虚妄！<NL>原来，昔日焕心与伏虞剑刃遭那妖魔吞吃，却并未就此消逝，<NL>此刻竟与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的不屈心志彼此共鸣，遥相呼应，重又迸发出撼天动地的磅礴力量！<NL><NL>只见相枢狂啸不绝，黑焰与白光猛烈升腾，交相冲撞，<NL>足令这庞然妖魔痛苦难当，再也撑持不住，只得将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />狠狠甩脱掌心……

e0c008c6-5d6d-4602-858c-20f95c32d449/Opt.en: (Gathering their thoughts, Taiwu focused on their Footwork Arts to protect themselves...)
e0c008c6-5d6d-4602-858c-20f95c32d449/Opt.cn: （强自汇聚心念，运转身法，护住自身……）
e0c008c6-5d6d-4602-858c-20f95c32d449/Opt.ru: (Собравшись с мыслями, Тайу сосредоточились на своем искусстве работы ногами, чтобы защитить себя...)

2f10e3d0-4d1c-45b9-a8eb-d9a4d39b6f62/Eve.en: The wind roared past, spinning <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> around, <NL>but they summoned the last of their strength to steady themselves!<NL>Landing firmly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> rose to face the demon, ready to sacrifice everything, a truly heroic sight.<NL>The hilt of the Fuyu Sword was gripped tightly in their hand, refusing to let go despite the pain...
2f10e3d0-4d1c-45b9-a8eb-d9a4d39b6f62/Eve.cn: 风声灌耳，身形几度翻转，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />强自提聚最后一丝气力，方才稳住身形！<NL>只见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />落地之后，便即起身，面对妖魔，竟是舍生望死，好不悲壮，<NL>那伏虔剑柄，正死死扣在其掌心，无论有如何苦楚，不曾放松丝毫……

2f10e3d0-4d1c-45b9-a8eb-d9a4d39b6f62/Opt.en: (Struggling to hold on, Taiwu looked towards Xiangshu...)
2f10e3d0-4d1c-45b9-a8eb-d9a4d39b6f62/Opt.ru: (Изо всех сил стараясь удержаться, Тайу посмотрел в сторону Сяншу...)

0f09345a-caa3-42dd-b747-5ca3ac1d3fb8/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was exhausted but still managed to stand, <NL>looking up at the demon.<NL><NL>black flames scorching the earth, leaving nothing but charred remains, <NL>mountains shattered, forests destroyed, and creatures vanished.<NL>Beneath Xiangshu's feet lay an endless chasm.<NL>Xiangshu, in sorrowful agony, raised its eight arms to the sky and roared:<NL>"You insignificant ants...<NL>Dare to dream of challenging me?<NL>Once I have fully consumed Huanxin, I will turn you and this world to dust!"
0f09345a-caa3-42dd-b747-5ca3ac1d3fb8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />已是力竭，却仍强撑而起，<NL>往那妖魔所在抬头望去，却见——<NL><NL>黑焰灼穿大地，人间处处焦土，<NL>千山尽碎，万木尽摧，鸟兽尽绝，相枢足下已是一道天堑鸿沟，深不见底！<NL>相枢痛苦万状，八臂遮天，仰首怒啸：<NL>“尔等小小蝼蚁……<NL>竟也异想天开，妄图撼动本座？<NL>只待本座将焕心侵蚀殆尽，到时，<NL>本座必让尔等蝼蚁凡人，连同这方天地，尽皆化作齑粉！”

d4e7c20c-c694-4883-a0d6-c28a526d4861/Eve.en: The furious roar seemed to crack the azure sky, <NL>revealing a glimpse of the heavens, and then the light grew brighter, <NL>illuminating Xiangshu's massive form as it slowly sank into the earth's fissure.<NL>The blood-red ash and dark mist followed, disappearing into the crevice until they were gone...<NL><NL>After a long while, the demon was nowhere to be seen, and silence returned, as if the fierce battle had been nothing but a nightmare.<NL>Though the plants were destroyed, the world remained, and the wind blew over the scorched earth without a sound...
d4e7c20c-c694-4883-a0d6-c28a526d4861/Eve.cn: 那声声怒喝，似将碧云也震裂，<NL>先是露出一角苍天，继而天光愈亮，<NL>照见相枢那庞然身影，缓缓沉入地缝之中！<NL>漫天的血灰，蔽日的黑雾，紧随其后没入裂隙，终于渐渐消失不见……<NL><NL>过了许久，那妖魔已全无踪迹，此地重归寂静，恍若方才那场恶战不过一场噩梦。<NL>草木虽毁，天地犹存，风过焦土，已不闻半点声息……

bdcc8ca9-3163-459d-b0b9-184fa7dd10ce/Eve.en: The sky cleared, revealing a desolate scene.<NL>The village, ravaged by the demon, lay in ruins.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s body felt like it was falling apart, unable to hold on any longer, they collapsed to the ground.<NL>As their consciousness faded, they glimpsed several figures in green rushing towards them from a distance...
bdcc8ca9-3163-459d-b0b9-184fa7dd10ce/Eve.cn: 天光重明，满目荒凉，<NL>村落遭妖魔肆虐，早已成一片废墟。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />浑身骨骼似已散架，再也支撑不住，颓然倒地，<NL>却在意识渐渐模糊，昏沉之际，依稀瞥见几道青色身影，正从不远处匆匆奔来……

bdcc8ca9-3163-459d-b0b9-184fa7dd10ce/Opt.en: That is... the Valley of Flowers...

019e516a-addb-4856-bd0e-bf7f4ca55f45/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> vaguely recalled, <NL>that the green attire was the usual garb of the Valley of Flowers disciples.<NL>Several disciples had arrived at the village, moving swiftly through the ruins,<NL>urgently calling out "Save them, save them," <NL>carefully lifting each injured person who still showed signs of life...
019e516a-addb-4856-bd0e-bf7f4ca55f45/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />朦胧忆起，<NL>那身青衣，定是百花谷弟子平日的装束。<NL>但见数名百花弟子已赶至村中，此刻穿行于废墟之间，四下奔走，<NL>正神情焦急，口中不住喊着“救人、救人”，<NL>将一个个尚有气息的伤者小心抬出……

f39b4077-05d6-42ad-9a38-f3ad16736d7c/Eve.en: Among the bustling disciples,<NL>a young woman suddenly spotted <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> lying on the ground.<NL>She hurried over, her skirt dusted with dirt, but she didn't care as she knelt down to administer aid.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s vision blurred, their eyes slowly closing, feeling a comforting warmth spreading from their heart.<NL>With a sense of relief, they drifted into a deep sleep...
f39b4077-05d6-42ad-9a38-f3ad16736d7c/Eve.cn: 诸多百花弟子，奔忙不止，<NL>其中忽有一名女子，终于寻见倒在地上的<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，<NL>她快步奔来，裙角沾满尘土，却顾不得拂去，便即蹲下身来施针相救。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />视线迷蒙，双目渐合，只觉一股温热的暖意自心口缓缓漾开，<NL>心头一松，这才沉沉睡去……

bed2048e-65ea-45de-b596-f023dad770d0/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> slowly awoke from a haze,<NL>their surroundings gradually becoming clear.<NL>They heard a soft rustling sound, sometimes gentle, sometimes urgent, as if something was being brushed against paper...
bed2048e-65ea-45de-b596-f023dad770d0/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />自溟濛中缓缓转醒，<NL>昏昏沉沉间，眼前景物渐渐分明，耳畔亦听得一阵簌簌声响，<NL>时而轻，时而急，似有何物于纸上摩挲……
bed2048e-65ea-45de-b596-f023dad770d0/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> медленно пробуждался от тумана,<NL>их окружение постепенно прояснялось.<NL>Они услышали тихий шелестящий звук, иногда нежный, иногда настойчивый, как будто что-то проводило щеткой по бумаге...

4bbc3e4c-23c0-4b49-85f3-082de82f4fe8/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turned their head with effort, <NL>and saw a small figure by the grass bed, peaceful and serene.<NL>Qi was safe, holding a piece of charcoal,<NL>focused on drawing on paper, completely unaware that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> had awakened.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looked closely and saw it was the fifth drawing that Seventh Sister hadn't finished before...
4bbc3e4c-23c0-4b49-85f3-082de82f4fe8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />勉力侧过头去，<NL>便见一道小小的身影守在草床之侧，此刻宁静祥和，<NL>七妹业已安然无事，手中捏着一截炭块，<NL>正低着头专注地在纸上涂画，全然不觉<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />已然醒来。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />凝神一看，那纸面上，正是七妹此前未曾画完的第五幅画……

55137823-be2d-4e73-822d-6decee721c0b/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s vision blurred again,<NL>and they strained to look at the fifth drawing by Qi:<NL>a figure in linen cloth struggling to stand, facing the Xiangshu demon!<NL>They held a bladeless sword hilt, and above their head were two crooked characters—<NL>Taiwu.
55137823-be2d-4e73-822d-6decee721c0b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />视线渐又昏朦，<NL>只得竭尽力气，望向七妹笔下那第五幅画：<NL>但见画中，一个身披麻布的人影艰难站起，直面那相枢妖魔！<NL>其手中仍还紧握一支无刃的剑柄，而那人头顶，竟歪歪斜斜写着两个大字——<NL>太吾。
55137823-be2d-4e73-822d-6decee721c0b/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />зрение снова затуманилось,<NL>и они напряглись, чтобы посмотреть на пятый рисунок Ци:<NL>фигура в льняной одежде, пытающаяся встать лицом к лицу с демоном Сяншу!<NL>Они держали рукоять Меча без лезвия, а над их головами были изображены два изогнутых символа—<NL>Тайу.

f23cd5ea-61bb-49eb-81ce-521c1acd8c16/Eve.en: Taiwu, Taiwu... so that's how it is...<NL>After seeing the fifth drawing clearly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> let out a long sigh.<NL>But as their eyes opened and closed, the surroundings transformed into a different world.<NL>Suddenly, a joyful voice broke into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s ears—<NL>"Taiwu, Taiwu, you little one, you're finally awake!"
f23cd5ea-61bb-49eb-81ce-521c1acd8c16/Eve.cn: 太吾，太吾……原来竟是这般……<NL>待得看清第五幅画，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />终是长长一叹，<NL>然而双目一阖一启，周遭景物却已是另一番天地。<NL>只听得一声惊喜的呼声闯入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />耳帘——<NL>“太吾太吾，你这娃娃，总算是醒了！”

949b9481-2654-4405-8c52-86da980c788c/Eve.en: Immortal Xu suddenly appeared by the bed, <NL>leaning in to examine <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> closely,<NL>then deliberately sighed and shook his head, saying:<NL><NL>"Oh dear, oh dear, after you passed out,<NL>the Sect Leaders of the fifteen sects waited here, not knowing how many days and nights they kept vigil!<NL>Only when your pulse stabilized and your life was no longer in danger did they return to their duties,<NL>leaving only me here, never leaving your side...<NL>But now, finally, I've waited for you to open your eyes!"
949b9481-2654-4405-8c52-86da980c788c/Eve.cn: 只见徐仙公倏然现于榻前，俯身凑近，<NL>将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />仔仔细细端详了一番，旋即故意长叹一声，<NL>摇头晃脑道：<NL><NL>“唉呀唉呀，那日你昏死过去之后，<NL>十五派掌门在此守候，竟已不知守了多少个日夜！<NL>直至你脉象渐稳、性命无虞，诸位才各自因门中要务而归去，<NL>唯独剩下老夫一人，仍守在你身边，寸步未曾离……<NL>如今好了，总算是盼到你这小娃睁眼了！”

949b9481-2654-4405-8c52-86da980c788c/Opt.en: (It seems my spirit has returned to the present world...)
949b9481-2654-4405-8c52-86da980c788c/Opt.cn: （看来我的心念，已然归返现世……）
949b9481-2654-4405-8c52-86da980c788c/Opt.ru: (Кажется, мой Дух вернулся в нынешний мир...)

8fd2397d-bdcf-4071-a292-fe45855a73ea/Eve.en: Immortal Xu's words flowed endlessly like a river,<NL>while <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> listened quietly, their mind gradually clearing.<NL>The surroundings felt peaceful and calm, bringing an unprecedented sense of relaxation.<NL>The previous torment seemed to have vanished completely, as if it had never existed...
8fd2397d-bdcf-4071-a292-fe45855a73ea/Eve.cn: 徐仙公如此絮絮叨叨，话头如流水一般淌个不停。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />默然静听，神思也渐渐清明，只觉四下里宁和安稳，身心皆是前所未有的松快，<NL>先前那痛彻肺腑的煎熬苦楚，此刻已去得干干净净，<NL>竟仿佛从未有过一般……

d018f97b-ba10-4455-af14-cf9884237efe/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> turned to look and saw Huanxin still lying beside them,<NL>their hands tightly clasped together, not loosening even a bit.<NL>However, Huanxin's face was pale, eyes shut, and though they were breathing,<NL>no amount of calling could wake them...
d018f97b-ba10-4455-af14-cf9884237efe/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />侧首望去，<NL>见焕心仍卧于身旁，二人双手紧紧握在一处，竟是一丝不曾松开。<NL>然而她此刻面色苍白，双眸紧闭，气息虽在，<NL>却任人怎么呼唤，也醒不过来……
d018f97b-ba10-4455-af14-cf9884237efe/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> повернулся посмотреть и увидел Хуаньсинь, все еще лежащую рядом с ними,<NL>их руки крепко сжались вместе, ни на йоту не разжимая.<NL>Однако лицо Хуаньсинь было бледным, глаза закрыты, и хотя они дышали,<NL>никакие звонки не могли их разбудить...

71b5c20b-e63b-444b-8267-6b69ab766468/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> tried to call out to Huanxin, but their throat was dry and hoarse,<NL>unable to produce a sound.<NL>As they struggled to sit up, Immortal Xu sighed softly nearby:<NL>"Huanxin's spirit is nearly shattered... almost completely gone...<NL>For now, staying by your side, Taiwu, is the only way to keep her alife..."
71b5c20b-e63b-444b-8267-6b69ab766468/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />张口欲唤焕心，<NL>喉间却是干涩嘶哑，半点声音也挤不出来，<NL>待得强撑起身，便听得徐仙公在一旁缓缓叹道：<NL>“这焕心女娃，心念已损得七七八八，可称是十成……去了九成……<NL>现下也唯有留在你太吾身侧，方能保住一丝气息不断呐……”

5f93931f-5fc7-430f-ade1-d816a448a90e/Eve.en: Upon hearing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> felt even more heartbroken.<NL>Immortal Xu, seeing their sorrowful expression, asked curiously:<NL>"What kind of calamity did you two face that caused her spirit to be so damaged?"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> remained silent for a while before finally recounting the entire story to Immortal Xu...
5f93931f-5fc7-430f-ade1-d816a448a90e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />闻言，愈发痛心难抑，<NL>徐仙公见其神色这般凄然，不由奇道：<NL>“你二人究竟遭了何等劫数，怎会令她心念损毁至此？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />默然半晌，终是将前尘旧事，从头至尾，一五一十说与徐仙公知晓……

5f93931f-5fc7-430f-ade1-d816a448a90e/Opt.cn: （细说念返前尘之时所见所闻……）

509f4412-22d0-405f-baa1-26239c204553/Eve.en: After a while, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finished speaking, and Immortal Xu suddenly understood:<NL>"No wonder, no wonder!<NL>That girl's spirit traveled back with you to hundreds of years ago,<NL>and with unwavering determination, she fought alongside you against Xiangshu,<NL>which is why she's so severely damaged!"
509f4412-22d0-405f-baa1-26239c204553/Eve.cn: 待得半刻之后，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />终于言罢，徐仙公方才恍然大悟道：<NL>“怪不得，怪不得！<NL>那小女娃的心念，竟是随你一道回了那数百年前，<NL>又拼着一股义无反顾的心气，与你并肩死战、共抗相枢，才受损如此之重！”

981ed3b6-3707-43e6-9656-1733fe71c98e/Eve.en: Immortal Xu clicked his tongue in wonder, shaking his head as he sighed:<NL>"You, young one, have had such an extraordinary encounter,<NL>able to revisit the past and shape old memories...<NL>It must be Huanxin's power resonating with yours that triggered this miracle..."
981ed3b6-3707-43e6-9656-1733fe71c98e/Eve.cn: 徐仙公啧啧称奇，摇头叹道：<NL>“你这小娃，竟有如此奇遇，<NL>得以念回过往，缔造前尘往事……<NL>想来定是焕心女娃的力量与你遥相共鸣，方得引发这等奇迹……”
981ed3b6-3707-43e6-9656-1733fe71c98e/Eve.ru: Бессмертный Сюй удивленно прищелкнул языком, качая головой и вздыхая:<NL>- У тебя, юноша, была такая необычная встреча,<NL>способный вернуться в прошлое и сформировать старые воспоминания...<NL>Должно быть, это сила Хуаньсинь, резонирующая с твоей, вызвала это чудо..."

981ed3b6-3707-43e6-9656-1733fe71c98e/Opt.en: But Huanxin remains unconscious, and it's uncertain when she will awaken...
981ed3b6-3707-43e6-9656-1733fe71c98e/Opt.cn: 只是焕心依旧昏迷不醒，不知何时才会醒来……
981ed3b6-3707-43e6-9656-1733fe71c98e/Opt.ru: Но Хуаньсинь остается без сознания, и неизвестно, когда она проснется...

1f083c9c-963b-4541-a0b4-646977d1f0dc/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s expression darkened as they spoke,<NL>and Immortal Xu sighed deeply, worry etched on their face:<NL>"Though Huanxin has been rescued, her life force is dwindling like a flickering candle.<NL>If she truly fades away, the Fuyu Sword will shatter with her.<NL>Without the Fuyu Sword to hold Xiangshu at bay, it will be unleashed like a beast freed from its cage,<NL>and this world will surely face destruction...<NL><NL>Alas, I suggest you all start planning for a future beyond this world's end!"
1f083c9c-963b-4541-a0b4-646977d1f0dc/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />言及此处，神色一黯，<NL>徐仙公亦是不住叹气，忧心忡忡道：<NL>“焕心女娃虽已救回，可她这性命却如灯油耗尽，日渐消逝，<NL>倘若她当真消散，伏虞剑也必随之崩毁，<NL>到那时，没了「伏虞剑」的牵制，相枢便如脱笼之兽，再无顾忌，<NL>这方天地定遭覆灭……<NL><NL>唉，依老夫看，诸位还是早些谋求天地覆灭后的去处为好！”

1f083c9c-963b-4541-a0b4-646977d1f0dc/Opt.en: When the nest is overturned, no egg remains unbroken...
1f083c9c-963b-4541-a0b4-646977d1f0dc/Opt.ru: Когда гнездо переворачивается, ни одно яйцо не остается целым...

1cc6ae7d-ea89-45ba-986b-ef4ee8287bb1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> shook their head gently,<NL>knowing that when the nest is overturned, no egg remains unbroken.<NL>If the world teeters on the brink, humanity will be plunged into endless suffering, leaving no place for refuge.<NL>Yet, Immortal Xu's words are not without merit; the immediate priority is to save Huanxin and help her recover swiftly.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gazed at the unconscious Huanxin, her small face pale as paper,<NL>her breath faint and barely perceptible...
1cc6ae7d-ea89-45ba-986b-ef4ee8287bb1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻轻摇头，<NL>心知覆巢之下，焉有完卵？<NL>待得天地倾覆，人间必将沦入无尽悲苦，又哪里还能寻得安身之所……<NL>然徐仙公所言却也不虚，当务之急，便是救下焕心，助她早日醒转复原。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />目光落向昏迷中的焕心，那张小小的脸庞苍白如纸，<NL>气息微弱，若有若无……

1cc6ae7d-ea89-45ba-986b-ef4ee8287bb1/Opt.en: Immortal, do you know of any way to save Huanxin's life?
1cc6ae7d-ea89-45ba-986b-ef4ee8287bb1/Opt.cn: 仙公可知，有何法子能救回焕心性命？
1cc6ae7d-ea89-45ba-986b-ef4ee8287bb1/Opt.ru: Бессмертный, знаешь ли ты какой-нибудь способ спасти жизнь Хуаньсинь?

9cfa6d1c-8faa-4bac-9cce-6004a5357d75/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was overwhelmed with sorrow, but seeing Immortal Xu's eyes light up, they suddenly said:<NL>"Matters of the mind are elusive and mysterious, even my knowledge barely scratches the surface.<NL>However, since Huanxin's mind was harmed by Xiangshu,<NL>perhaps... you could seek out Tainted for advice..."
9cfa6d1c-8faa-4bac-9cce-6004a5357d75/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中本已悲极，却见徐仙公眼珠一转，忽而道：<NL>“心念之事缥缈玄异，便连老夫所知，也不过皮毛。<NL>不过，焕心女娃这心念既是受相枢所伤，如今要想治她，<NL>或许……可去寻那染尘子一问……”

4750e8fe-07ae-40c6-a27a-7708e897e0d5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pondered silently:<NL>Taoist Tainted's origins are unclear, and his intentions are unknown.<NL>This person has always been indifferent to the affairs of demons and monsters, seemingly unconcerned with the world.<NL>I'm afraid even if we seek him out, it might be in vain...
4750e8fe-07ae-40c6-a27a-7708e897e0d5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />暗自思忖：<NL>那染尘子道长，来处不明，其心中有何意欲，亦是全然不知。<NL>此人素来无心妖魔之事，世间万物，好似全不挂怀，<NL>只怕此番纵是寻他相问，亦是徒劳无功……

4750e8fe-07ae-40c6-a27a-7708e897e0d5/Opt.en: I'm afraid the Taoist has no interest in matters of demons and monsters. Seeking him might be futile...
4750e8fe-07ae-40c6-a27a-7708e897e0d5/Opt.cn: 只怕道长无心妖魔之事，纵是寻他亦无甚用……
4750e8fe-07ae-40c6-a27a-7708e897e0d5/Opt.ru: Боюсь, даоса не интересуют демоны и чудовища. Поиски его могут оказаться тщетными...

0ca17d1a-4ca6-4a1b-95fd-ee2d24d6e37e/Eve.en: Immortal Xu sighed deeply and waved their hand gently, saying:<NL>"Don't be hasty. Let me tell you slowly.<NL>Previously, I learned a bit about Tainted's past from a young blacksmith..."<NL><NL>With that, he focused his thoughts and began to recount what he knew.
0ca17d1a-4ca6-4a1b-95fd-ee2d24d6e37e/Eve.cn: 徐仙公长叹一声，轻轻摆手说道：<NL>“小娃娃，你且莫急，容老夫慢慢说与你听。<NL>此前，老夫曾从那小铁匠口中，得知染尘子几分过往……”<NL><NL>只听得他凝神追忆，将所知所闻，娓娓道来。
0ca17d1a-4ca6-4a1b-95fd-ee2d24d6e37e/Eve.ru: Бессмертный Сюй глубоко вздохнул и мягко махнул им рукой, сказав:<NL>- Не торопись. Позвольте мне рассказать вам медленно.<NL>Ранее я узнал немного о прошлом Tainted от молодого кузнеца..."<NL><NL>С этими словами он сосредоточил свои мысли и начал пересказывать то, что ему было известно.

1173bc72-199a-48e2-8773-bc8ad487f3a4/Eve.en: Tainted... <NL>was originally a celestial child from Mt. Chai beyond the East Sea,<NL>born from a boulder, devoid of the emotions and desires of living beings.<NL>Because of this, Tainted is immune to Xiangshu's influence, and was entrusted by the immortals to oversee the furnace that tempered Xiangshu...
1173bc72-199a-48e2-8773-bc8ad487f3a4/Eve.cn: “那染尘子……<NL>本是东海之外，柴山上的一名仙童，<NL>因乃顽石化生，生来便无世间生灵之七情六欲。<NL>也正因此，染尘子不受相枢扰惑，故而受神仙托付，负责看管熬炼相枢的梏妖神炉……”

0530b53f-2de9-4860-bb2d-810a833c3c92/Eve.en: Later, Xiangshu somehow managed to break free from the seal of the demon-forging furnace.<NL>The Twelve Immortals of Kunlun, who uphold the world's order, were furious upon hearing this <NL>and immediately sent Tainted to subdue Xiangshu...
0530b53f-2de9-4860-bb2d-810a833c3c92/Eve.cn: “后来，相枢不知使了何等手段，竟自梏妖神炉中破禁而出。<NL>执掌乾坤纲常，维系世间秩序的昆仑十二上仙，闻讯大怒，<NL>当即命染尘子戴罪出山，前往降伏相枢……”
0530b53f-2de9-4860-bb2d-810a833c3c92/Eve.ru: Позже Сяншу каким-то образом удалось освободиться от Печати печи для ковки демонов.<NL>Двенадцать Бессмертных Куньлуня, которые поддерживают мировой порядок, пришли в ярость, услышав это <NL>и немедленно отправил Испорченного усмирять Сяншу...

0530b53f-2de9-4860-bb2d-810a833c3c92/Opt.en: Could it be true that the Twelve Immortals exist?
0530b53f-2de9-4860-bb2d-810a833c3c92/Opt.ru: Может ли быть правдой, что двенадцать Бессмертных существуют?

6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was taken aback to hear that the Twelve Immortals truly exist.<NL>Then, they listened as Immortal Xu continued:<NL><NL>Tainted set out as instructed, <NL>wandering the world for a thousand years, living through ten lifetimes.<NL>In each life, he received guidance from the Twelve Immortals, searching for the most genuine and passionate things in the world to forge into a Divine Sword to subdue Xiangshu.<NL>Yet, despite countless searches and trials, it was all in vain—<NL>each life ended with Tainted's death and his soul's return to the cycle of reincarnation.
6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听闻世间竟真有十二上仙，心中不免一惊，<NL>又听徐仙公继续说道：<NL><NL>“染尘子依命而去，<NL>于世间辗转浮沉，历经千年，轮回十世。<NL>每世皆受十二上仙指点，遍寻天下至情至性之物，铸为神剑，用以降伏相枢，<NL>然则百般寻觅，千般试炼，终是徒劳——<NL>每一世，染尘子皆以身死神灭、坠入轮回而终。”

6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.en: The Twelve Immortals possess great powers, able to guide the swordsmiths, so why can't they take action themselves to vanquish the demon?
6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.cn: 十二上仙神通广大，既能指点铸剑，却何以不能出手降魔？
6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.ru: Двенадцать Бессмертных обладают великой силой, способной направлять кузнецов меча, так почему же они сами не могут предпринять действия, чтобы победить демона?

6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.en: Even after forging nine divine swords, why was it still in vain?
6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.cn: 既已炼成九柄神剑，何以仍是徒劳？
6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.ru: Даже после того, как он выковал девять божественных мечей, почему это все равно было напрасно?

6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.en: So that's the origin of the nine divine swords...
6c1d4201-a43e-453e-a7ec-253f69382a42/Opt.ru: Так вот откуда взялись девять божественных мечей...

a3caad56-e947-49ab-ab33-7c02413ea1ef/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pondered silently, then continued to listen to Immortal Xu:<NL><NL>It wasn't until the final life that Tainted used the Fuyu Sword to seal Xiangshu.<NL>The "Fuyu Sword" was forged by merging the divine swords of their previous nine lives with divine fire.<NL>Although Huanxin was not yet present, its power was already immense and extraordinary...
a3caad56-e947-49ab-ab33-7c02413ea1ef/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中默想，复又静听徐仙公所言。<NL><NL>“直至最后一世，染尘子方以伏虞剑将相枢封印。<NL>那「伏虞剑」，乃是集其前九世所铸神剑于一，以神火熔铸而成，<NL>彼时虽尚无焕心女娃，却已是威能浩荡，非同小可……”

fa6e9354-afff-4d64-ac56-f509a9b94ee7/Eve.en: The Twelve Immortals of Kunlun must be incredibly powerful.<NL>If they can guide Tainted in swordsmithing, why don't they take action themselves and instead let Xiangshu wreak havoc?<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> was puzzled and asked, to which Immortal Xu chuckled and shook his head, sighing:<NL><NL>There might be hidden reasons behind the actions of immortals.<NL>It's a pity I was just one step away from becoming an immortal myself; otherwise, I could have ascended to the heavens and asked them directly...
fa6e9354-afff-4d64-ac56-f509a9b94ee7/Eve.cn: 那昆仑十二上仙想必神通广大，<NL>既能指点染尘子铸剑，何不亲自出手，反倒放任相枢为祸世间？<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心有此惑，便即问出，徐仙公却是哑然失笑，摇头叹道：<NL><NL>“神仙之事，其中或有隐情，<NL>可惜老夫只差一步便能成仙，否则定可直上九天，去那玉阙瑶台问个明白……”

ce3b3d8e-dfbc-400d-8b12-a3d4fa025cea/Eve.en: Immortal Xu said:<NL>Tainted could never compare to you...<NL>He was born from a boulder, devoid of emotion, his heart as still as a dry well.<NL>Even with the divine swords, each imbued with power, in his hands, they were nothing more than ordinary iron.<NL>He was unable to unleash the true power of the sword and wield them freely...
ce3b3d8e-dfbc-400d-8b12-a3d4fa025cea/Eve.cn: 徐仙公道：<NL>“那染尘子，却万万及不上你……<NL>他本是顽石化生，无情无感，心如枯井不起波澜，<NL>纵是九柄神剑各俱神力，于他手中，亦不过是顽铁一柄，<NL>终究难以催动剑中真力，运用自如……”

ce3b3d8e-dfbc-400d-8b12-a3d4fa025cea/Opt.en: So without emotions, it's difficult to wield the nine divine swords freely...
ce3b3d8e-dfbc-400d-8b12-a3d4fa025cea/Opt.cn: （原来若无七情六欲，便难以将那九柄神剑运用自如……）
ce3b3d8e-dfbc-400d-8b12-a3d4fa025cea/Opt.ru: Так что без эмоций трудно свободно владеть девятью божественными мечами...

f6102ecf-e023-4119-b8d0-a968a6a488b7/Eve.en: Though the Xiangshu was sealed by the Fuyu Sword,<NL>Tainted was deeply corrupted by it, affecting their mind profoundly. He had no choice but to imprison himself on Mt. Chai, cutting off all ties with the world.<NL>As for why he later left Mt. Chai...<NL>I have no idea, <NL><NL>Immortal Xu finished speaking, letting out a long breath as if parched from the tale.
f6102ecf-e023-4119-b8d0-a968a6a488b7/Eve.cn: “只是那相枢虽被「伏虞剑」封住，<NL>染尘子却也遭其侵蚀，心神受染极深，不得已将自己囚禁于柴山，自此与世隔绝。<NL>至于后来他为何又离开柴山……<NL>老夫便不得而知了。”<NL><NL>徐仙公语毕，长长舒出一口气，似已说得口干舌燥……

f6102ecf-e023-4119-b8d0-a968a6a488b7/Opt.en: Earlier, it was said that Tainted was devoid of emotions. How could he be corrupted at the moment of success?
f6102ecf-e023-4119-b8d0-a968a6a488b7/Opt.cn: 此前才道，染尘子道长无情无感，如何在功成之时，反受侵蚀？
f6102ecf-e023-4119-b8d0-a968a6a488b7/Opt.ru: Ранее говорилось, что Tainted был лишен эмоций. Как он мог быть испорчен в момент успеха?

f6102ecf-e023-4119-b8d0-a968a6a488b7/Opt.cn: 却不知染尘子道长如今何在……

7759cc59-8936-4ae8-912a-88fd912474db/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> suddenly remembered the last time they saw Tainted was when<NL>Long Yufu broke the dark mist surrounding the Sword Mound.<NL>As the mist dissipated, Long Yufu was barely alive, and Tainted mentioned he was going to find someone, then left with her.<NL>After that, the two vanished without a trace...
7759cc59-8936-4ae8-912a-88fd912474db/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />蓦然忆起，<NL>此前与染尘子最后相见，便是在龙语茯破开禁锢剑冢的黑雾之时，<NL>彼时黑雾溃散，龙语茯奄奄一息，染尘子只道要前去寻一个人，便即携她离去。<NL>此后，二人便如石沉大海，再无半点音讯……

7759cc59-8936-4ae8-912a-88fd912474db/Opt.en: Immortal Xu, do you know where Tainted might be now?
7759cc59-8936-4ae8-912a-88fd912474db/Opt.cn: 仙公可知晓染尘子道长如今去向？
7759cc59-8936-4ae8-912a-88fd912474db/Opt.ru: Бессмертный Сюй, ты знаешь, где сейчас может быть Испорченный?

8af9c015-1003-4c2d-ac25-bb7e43693e93/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> couldn't hide their surprise and asked,<NL>hearing Immortal Xu sigh softly:<NL>"Tainted was indeed emotionless before,<NL>but over ten lifetimes spanning a thousand years, he experienced all joys and sorrows, faced countless quietus,<NL>and unknowingly, the heart of the immortal child formed from a boulder became filled with the grief of ten lifetimes of death.<NL>This grief became his everything...<NL><NL>The Xiangshu affects all sentient beings, none can escape its curse.<NL>Emotionless turned emotional, even a boulder developed a mortal heart, and thus, Tainted ultimately became possessed..."
8af9c015-1003-4c2d-ac25-bb7e43693e93/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />惊异难抑，不由问出心中不解，<NL>只听得徐仙公低声叹道：<NL>“那染尘子从前确是无情无感，<NL>可是十世千年，他尝遍悲欢，历尽死劫，<NL>不知不觉，那个顽石所化的仙童心中，早已满是十世身死的愁苦。<NL>而这十世的愁苦，又已是他的全部……<NL><NL>相枢之为物，凡有情众生，尽皆难逃其祸。<NL>无情变作有情，顽石亦生凡心，盖因如此，染尘子终究入魔……”

8af9c015-1003-4c2d-ac25-bb7e43693e93/Opt.en: This grief from ten lifetimes made it difficult to resist the curse of the Xiangshu... How tragic...
8af9c015-1003-4c2d-ac25-bb7e43693e93/Opt.cn: 因这十世愁苦，反倒难以抵御相枢之祸……可悲可叹……
8af9c015-1003-4c2d-ac25-bb7e43693e93/Opt.ru: Это горе, пережитое в течение десяти жизней, затрудняло сопротивление проклятию Сяншу... Как трагично...

7ab45436-df20-48f5-9aca-dc606ce6de57/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> furrowed their brow, understanding:<NL>Someone like Tainted, with immense power but lacking the mind to resist the Xiangshu,<NL>even if he subdued demons, it would only be a temporary victory. Ultimately, he would be unable to escape the curse of the Xiangshu...
7ab45436-df20-48f5-9aca-dc606ce6de57/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眉头微蹙，心中已是了然：<NL>如染尘子这般空有一身神力，却无抵御相枢的心性，<NL>便是降伏了妖魔，也不过是一时之功，终究难逃相枢之祸……
7ab45436-df20-48f5-9aca-dc606ce6de57/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> нахмурили брови, понимая:<NL>Кто-то вроде Испорченного, обладающий огромной силой, но лишенный разума, чтобы противостоять Сяншу,<NL>даже если бы он покорил демонов, это была бы лишь временная победа. В конечном счете, он не смог бы избежать проклятия Сяншу...

7ab45436-df20-48f5-9aca-dc606ce6de57/Opt.en: But Tainted hasn't completely lost his mind, surely he has a way to deal with it?
7ab45436-df20-48f5-9aca-dc606ce6de57/Opt.cn: 只是染尘子道长神志并未全失，想来必有应对之法？
7ab45436-df20-48f5-9aca-dc606ce6de57/Opt.ru: Но Испорченный не совсем сошел с ума, наверняка у него есть способ справиться с этим?

Surely he has gained some insights.<NL>Perhaps he has already discovered some methods or hidden solutions that might help you cure Huanxin..."
6ac9f633-b9ea-43cd-9b22-a525df93aca4/Eve.cn: 徐仙公捋了捋“胡须”，似是深以为然，继而又道：<NL>“且不说「伏虞剑」与他渊源颇深，<NL>染尘子受相枢侵蚀多年，苦苦支撑至今，未必没有几分心得。<NL>或许他早已悟出些许门道，又或另藏法子，说不得，便能助你救治焕心女娃……”

22d23392-c917-4b02-a303-d0ca87feee18/Eve.en: Immortal Xu burst into laughter, clearly pleased with himself:<NL>"Haha! Don't worry.<NL>Someone has already gone ahead to track down Tainted, and we've received word recently—<NL>they're currently at Mt. Chai!"
22d23392-c917-4b02-a303-d0ca87feee18/Eve.cn: 徐仙公当即抚掌大笑，颇有几分自得道：<NL>“哈哈哈！小娃啊小娃，你只管放宽心便是，<NL>如今早已有人为你先行一步，前去寻找染尘子的踪迹，且近日已传回音讯——<NL>他们眼下……正在那柴山！”
22d23392-c917-4b02-a303-d0ca87feee18/Eve.ru: Бессмертный Сюй расхохотался, явно довольный собой:<NL>- Ха-ха! Не волнуйся.<NL>Кто-то уже отправился на поиски Испорченного, и недавно мы получили известие—<NL>в данный момент они находятся на горе Чай!"

22d23392-c917-4b02-a303-d0ca87feee18/Opt.en: (Gone ahead of me? Who could it be...?)

00cc5eee-bb9c-4f30-8c6e-2451b3adcb58/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听罢心生讶异，不由暗自寻思：<NL>究竟何人，竟已先行一步？<NL>默然思忖片刻，方才察觉，似已许久未见<SpecialName key=AdoptiveFather/>身影，终于心中恍然——<NL>必是<SpecialName key=AdoptiveFather/>早已动身，前去寻那染尘子了！

f0492be8-23c2-4998-a5a4-0ca5f15f4cd4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />果真一语中的，<NL>只见徐仙公连连点头，欣慰笑道：<NL>“不错，不错……你这娃娃，好生聪明！”
f0492be8-23c2-4998-a5a4-0ca5f15f4cd4/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> был в точку,<NL>пока Бессмертный Сюй несколько раз кивал, удовлетворенно улыбаясь:<NL>- Да, да... Ты очень умная, малышка!"

Listen to me carefully."<NL>Immortal Xu suddenly reached out and produced a reed from seemingly nowhere, handing it to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><NL>The reed was long and smooth, with a shimmering glow.<NL>Though it appeared ordinary, it was exceptionally tough,<NL>bending without breaking, a truly curious sight...
ad7488fe-be9f-43b6-83a9-7715d78e250f/Eve.cn: “小娃娃莫急、莫急，且听老夫细说。”<NL>徐仙公忽尔伸手，不知从何处取出一支芦苇，递到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />面前。<NL><NL>但见那芦苇细长一根，光滑顺直，莹莹泛光，<NL>然其看似寻常，却又格外坚韧，<NL>任是如何弯折，自是岿然不动，不曲不折，瞧来甚是奇异……

Chai without delay..."
706e03bf-3530-481e-9d76-5cfc396a5145/Eve.cn: 徐仙公笑道：<NL>“柴山远在东海之外，烟波浩渺，舟楫难渡，<NL>凡人纵有通天本事，也难踏足半步。<NL><NL>你且收好这支芦苇，持它在手，便可自灵山岛瞬息抵达柴山，片刻不误……”

706e03bf-3530-481e-9d76-5cfc396a5145/Opt.en: I see, thank you, Immortal Xu... (Taking the reed...)
706e03bf-3530-481e-9d76-5cfc396a5145/Opt.cn: 原来如此，多谢仙公……（收下芦苇……）
706e03bf-3530-481e-9d76-5cfc396a5145/Opt.ru: Я понимаю, спасибо тебе, Бессмертный Сюй... (Берет тростинку...)

bb892b02-0ca5-46fd-b685-39beab8a4f91/Eve.cn: “此去柴山，吉凶未卜……”<NL><NL>话语之间，只见徐仙公木手掐指细算，琢磨片刻，忽地咂舌道：<NL>“哎呀，此事拖延不得！这芦苇既已交到你手，<NL>老夫便也先行一步，自去柴山与小铁匠会合，一道等着你来便是！<NL>你既要带着那女娃同行，慢些倒也无妨……”<NL><NL>言罢，徐仙公告别<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，步履轻快，启程而去……
